description: Maps a stored block colour onto the data-palette token names. A document saved before 2.10.0 stores the picker hex; a new document stores the colour name. Both render through --tm-notion-color-*, so the theme decides the colour.

members.name: Name
members.description: Returns the palette name (gray, red, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple, pink, brown) for a legacy picker hex, or the stored value unchanged when it is already a name or unknown.

parameters.name: stored
parameters.description: The colour stored on the block: a palette name, a legacy hex, or null.

members.name: InlineHex
members.description: The one allowlisted legacy hex document.execCommand will keep. The toolbar paints the swatch from the token and sends this hex; null when the name is not on the palette.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: A palette name such as brown. Anything else returns null.

parameters.name: background
parameters.description: True for the highlight hex, false for the text hex.

members.name: OptionSolid
members.description: The option chip token var(--tm-notion-option-{name}-solid) for a stored name or legacy hex, or var(--tm-color-primary) when the value is empty or unknown.

parameters.name: stored
parameters.description: The option colour: a palette name, a legacy hex, or null.
